name: silvershop-suite/decimal-quantity
description: Per-product decimal / fractional order quantities for SilverShop (CMS 6) — sell some products by weight/length/area (kg, m², m) while others stay whole-unit, in one catalogue. Opt-in per product (QuantityIsDecimal + unit label + step/precision/min/max); carries the decimal beside core's integer quantity via extension hooks (no core overrides), with guarded decimal stock when silvershop/stock is installed.

suggest.silvershop/stock: Decimal per-warehouse stock for decimal-quantity products (guarded; without it pricing/cart/display still work).
suggest.tractorcow/silverstripe-fluent: Localise the per-product unit-of-measure label (m²/kg/…) per locale.
suggest.silvershop-suite/storefront: Renders the decimal quantity input on the PDP/cart; any theme works once the field is wired in.
